limitations: Host tests model serialized constructor/destructor protocols, not device MMIO or whole-driver concurrency.
MT6755 preserves errors from its entered WMT probe; no matching device or framework failure before WMT probe gives -ENODEV.
Failed/deferred fixed-device probes require a later explicit WMT init retry; automatic provider retry is not promised.
The platform fixture uses legacy abstract ops. The separate probe fixture executes the actual MT6755-required path.
Other IC private resources, optional callbacks unused by MT6755, runtime power sequencing and EMI-MPU restoration remain outside this patch.
